A LITTLE MORE ABOUT ME

Curious by nature.
Usually up for a plan.

I studied computer science at IIT Kharagpur, then worked at Adobe, GitHub, and Onehouse. My work has moved between product engineering, infrastructure, and AI agents.

Outside work, there’s usually house music playing. I’m into sunset drives, gaming, good food, and cocktail bars, especially with good company.

I’m the friend who’s happy to help and usually says yes to the plan. I like meeting people, trying things, and leaving room for something spontaneous.
